COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 551 of 2024
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
(1) Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel 
for the petitioner. 
(2) Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
(3) Petitioner has challenged the order 
dated 05.10.2023 passed by State 
Information Commissioner in Appeal No. 
37107, whereby penalty of ₹10,000/- has 
been imposed upon petitioner. A further 
direction has been issued to initiate 
disciplinary proceedings against the 
petitioner. 
(4) Issue notice to respondent nos. 1 & 2 
returnable within four weeks. 
(5) Steps to be taken on or before 
05.03.2024.
(6) List this case on 06.05.2024.
(7) In the meantime, subject to petitioner 
depositing ₹10,000/- in the Registry of this 
Court within two weeks from today, the 
direction to initiate disciplinary proceedings 
against the petitioner shall remain stayed. 
(6) Interim relief application (IA No. 1 of 
2024) stands disposed of. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
01.03.2024
Aswal
